response.sql:
WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT
    ordersmark,
    AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remaincount,
    COUNT(*) AS execution_count
  FROM orderexecutions
  WHERE expirespot::text > '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496'
    AND expirespot::text < '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533'
  GROUP BY ordersmark
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_remaincount) AS avg_of_per_order_averages,
  SUM(execution_count) AS total_execution_count
FROM per_order;

assumptions.assumption: Executions with a NULL ordersmark form one group, as in SQL GROUP BY; their count contributes to the total and their average contributes when non-NULL remaincount values exist.
